text:
Maria Gomez: FYI we found ~$12,340 in Feb GPU charges that look split across multiple customers but are billed to a single infra project (prod-shared-nodes). Need to attribute and issue credits where appropriate before invoices go out.

Tom Willis: Oof. Do we know which customers are affected? Any chance this is a GCP shared host billing quirk?

Ajay Patel: I pulled usage logs. The cluster is autoscaled with preemptible pools that get billed under prod-shared-nodes. The per-instance labels are dropped at billing time; usage_export shows only the host project id. Rough mapping I generated: acme-corp -> 48%, beta-startup -> 32%, internal-analytics -> 20%.

Nora Kim: Sales - acme-corp here. If this hits their invoice they will push back. We need a credit memo and an explanation doc. Also please scope whether this affects March so we can proactively communicate.

Maria Gomez: Proposed plan: (1) split the $12,340 according to Ajay's mapping and create internal chargeback entries, (2) issue prorated credits to external customers with a short explanatory note, (3) open cloud vendor ticket asking for line-itemized billing for shared nodes going forward. Agree?

billing-bot: Automated reconciliation note: Unattributed shared-node GPU spend = $12,339.82 for invoice period 2026-02. Reconciliation ID: REC-202602-88. Report: https://billing.internal/reports/REC-202602-88

Ajay Patel: I can produce the per-customer usage CSV and run the split. SQL I used to aggregate by customer label (best-effort):
```sql
SELECT customer_label, SUM(cost) AS cost_share
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_exports.compute`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-02' AND project.id = 'prod-shared-nodes'
GROUP BY customer_label
```
Note: customer_label is sometimes null, so mapping used instance metadata joins to our allocation table.

Tom Willis: When you have the CSV, I'll create the credit memos and route to accounting for approval. For external customers, credits need CSM + legal sign-off if > $5k. Acme will need the legal note.

Nora Kim: I'll draft the customer note. Keep it factual: root cause = shared-host billing aggregation; remediation = credit + next-step to prevent recurrence. Send me the amounts so I can pre-clear with their CSM.

Maria Gomez: Vendor action: @VendorSupport - can you confirm if you can provide instance-level line items for shared host billing or if we should change topology? We need this to be prevented programmatically.

VendorSupport: Thanks for the report. Please open a support ticket with the invoice ids and the affected project id. We can escalate for line-itemization; engineering may need to enable detailed usage logs (additional cost). ETA for initial response: 48h.

Ajay Patel: Opened internal ticket TICKET-8401 to run the allocation and produce CSV. Attaching sample mapping file: /infra/allocations/prod-shared-nodes-feb.csv

Maria Gomez: Tom/Nora, once credits are ready, let's also update the monthly cost forecast and subtract credits so our MRR view matches. Finance will hold final invoice publication until we confirm credits applied.

Tom Willis: Created credit memos draft: CM-2026-02-ACME ($5,920.72), CM-2026-02-BETA ($3,948.74), CM-2026-02-INTERNAL ($2,470.36). Sending to Legal & CSM for approval.

billing-bot: Credit memos queued; approval required: CM-2026-02-ACME. Link: https://billing.internal/credits/CM-2026-02-ACME

Nora Kim: Approved by CSM for acme-corp. Legal pinged. I'll send the customer note after legal approves wording.

Ajay Patel: Follow-up: I'll add a daily check for prod-shared-nodes that flags > $500/day unattributed to #finance and #eng. Also recommended a policy: require customer labels at instance creation; will PR a gating script.

Maria Gomez: Good. Let's aim to have credits applied and invoices updated before 2026-03-05 EOD. Thanks everyone.
